description: This PHP class defines validation logic for country codes within the OrangeHRM system, specifically by extending an abstract validation rule and utilizing a service to verify if a given input corresponds to a valid country code.

classes.name: CountryCode
classes.description: A validation rule class that checks whether a given input string is a valid country code by leveraging the CountryService.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input as a country code by checking if it is a string and corresponds to an existing Country entity via the CountryService.
